description.value: Snugglers Cottage is a self-contained vacation rental house situated in Snug Cove on Bowen Island, a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay on BC's Lower Mainland. The island is a popular cycling day-trip and overnight destination, and the cottage offers a private residential-style stay. As an Airbnb listing it operates without on-site staff, with all arrangements handled through the platform and the host remotely.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website prefetch returned only generic Airbnb navigation pages (help centre, gift cards, login, co-host) with no property-specific content; the actual listing detail did not render, leaving OSM tags as the sole usable source. OSM confirms the property as a guest_house at 1101 Miller Road, Bowen Island, with internet_access=wlan and a phone number, but provides no evidence for bike storage, staff procedures, or any other cyclist amenities. Because this is an Airbnb self-service rental, traditional front-desk staff are absent by design, and no amenity details can be verified from the available evidence.
concerns: Airbnb listing page failed to render property-specific content — only generic Airbnb boilerplate was captured; all amenity fields are unverifiable from website.
Property is a self-service Airbnb rental with no traditional front-desk staff, which may preclude meeting the 'Staff know the bike procedure' required criterion.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag could not be confirmed from website content.
No address corroboration from website; contact_confirmed fields set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Airbnb listing page did not render usable property-specific content, leaving all cyclist-relevant amenities (bike storage, Wi-Fi, laundry, etc.) unverifiable. As a self-service Airbnb rental with no on-site staff, it is unclear whether the property meets the WWC staff-knowledge criterion; a manual review of the live Airbnb listing or direct host contact is needed before a decision can be made.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bowen Island is reached by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay; cyclists touring the island would benefit from verified accommodation listings. A direct host inquiry via Airbnb messaging could quickly resolve bike storage and Wi-Fi questions.
